name: LogoLoop-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the most complete run of logos with none clipped by the edges.

tagline: Brand logos glide sideways in an endless fading strip.
summary: A single row of white brand marks scrolls steadily past under a small "Trusted by teams at" label, dissolving at both edges and pausing for the pointer.
appearance: A strip of white monochrome brand logos, all the same height, evenly spaced on black, with a small centred label above. Both ends fade out into the background.
behaviour: The row slides left in a continuous loop that wraps around itself without a jump. Hovering slows it to a stop and each logo grows slightly under the pointer.
demo_content: Label "Trusted by teams at" above logos for Apple, Google, Meta, Netflix, Spotify, Stripe, Vercel and Airbnb.
search_phrases: logo carousel with pause on hover
use_when: A landing page needs to show a set of customer or partner logos in a narrow band.
avoid_when: It never stops unless hovered, and the built-in edge fade needs a matching background colour.
customise: Pass a logos array of icon nodes or image sources with optional links. Speed, direction, width, logo height, gap, hover behaviour, fades, scale and aria label are props.
weight_why: A single requestAnimationFrame loop transforms one track; no per-logo animation.

a11y.note: Duplicate logo copies are aria-hidden and the strip has a region label; reduced-motion stops the scroll entirely.

issues: The demo logos have no links, so none of them can be clicked or focused.
The edge fade only matches a dark background unless fadeOutColor is set.
polish_why: Clean seamless loop and tidy spacing; it is the standard logo marquee with little character.
title: Logo Marquee Loop
